name: Devon Bontrager
title: Electrical Engineering @ University of Kansas • Mathematics & Statistics
bio: I'm an Electrical Engineering student at the University of Kansas with a research focus on computational methods. I build research-focused systems in Python and C++, with interests spanning quantum computing, numerical optimization, high-performance computing, and scientific software.
highlights: EKF-based track-building framework for TrackML / HEP
Quantum computing experiments and published quantum algorithms
Optimization, simulation, and scientific computing systems
